question: Which place will Japan receive the most foreign visitors from during November 2026?

calls.reasoning: China's travel advisory against Japan has been in force since Nov 2025; Chinese arrivals fell 44.5% YoY in Sept 2026 to ~431k and 55.5% YTD. South Korea hit a record 842k in Sept 2026, with Taiwan at ~596k. November is a seasonally strong month for Korea. Only a sharp Chinese rebound or a collapse in Korean travel would flip the result. No matching human market was found; the Polymarket candidates are about Miss Universe and are irrelevant.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the core facts: Sep 2026 Korea 842k, Taiwan 596k, China ~408-431k; Jan-Sep Korea 8.26M leading; China advisory still in force and only partly eased. The only factual discrepancy (China's Sep figure, 408k vs 431k) is immaterial.
